entities.name: MUSIM UE
entities.description: A UE that supports one or more MUSIM features including NAS signalling connection release, paging indication for voice services, reject paging request, paging restriction, and paging timing collision control.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which the UE indicates support for MUSIM features and the network may accept them.

entities.name: Normal tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by the UE to indicate support for MUSIM features and by the network to accept them. Also used when UE stops being a MUSIM UE to indicate feature withdrawal.

entities.name: NAS signalling connection release
entities.description: A MUSIM feature that allows release of NAS signalling connection.

entities.name: Paging indication for voice services
entities.description: A MUSIM feature for paging indication specific to voice services. Not indicated in NB-S1 mode or WB-S1 mode CE mode B.

entities.name: Reject paging request
entities.description: A MUSIM feature allowing the UE to reject paging requests.

entities.name: Paging restriction
entities.description: A MUSIM feature for restricting paging. Indicated only if UE supports NAS signalling connection release or reject paging request.

entities.name: Paging timing collision control
entities.description: A MUSIM feature for controlling paging timing collisions.

entities.name: Attach for emergency bearer services
entities.description: Attach procedure for emergency services during which network does not indicate support for any MUSIM feature.

entities.name: Condition to be considered a MUSIM UE
entities.description: Condition defined in subclause 3.1. If UE stops fulfilling this condition, it must initiate normal TAU to withdraw MUSIM feature support.

relations.description: MUSIM UE indicates support for MUSIM features during attach procedure.
MUSIM UE indicates support for MUSIM features during normal tracking area updating procedure.
UE indicates support of paging restriction only if it supports NAS signalling connection release or reject paging request.
UE indicates support of paging restriction only if it supports NAS signalling connection release or reject paging request.
Network does not indicate support for any MUSIM feature during attach for emergency bearer services.
If UE stops fulfilling MUSIM UE condition, it initiates normal TAU to indicate MUSIM features are not supported.
MUSIM UE in NB-S1 mode or WB-S1 mode CE mode B does not indicate support for paging indication for voice services.
